name: gmail_read
description: Opens one message of the last gmail_inbox list: sender, recipients, date and the full text, and downloads every attachment (and every picture pasted in the body) into the workspace. Use it when the user wants to know what a message says, what it asks for, or needs its documents. It needs the number from that list; if you do not have it, call gmail_inbox first. Excel and Word files also get a .txt copy. Returns the message and the path of each saved file: open images and PDFs with Read at that exact path. Nothing is marked as read.

number.description: Number of the message in the last gmail_inbox list (e.g. 3).
